listing.name: Amped 2 (Amped2-Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Linux package; Windows route held Limits: Experimental Linux route; Windows explicitly unplayable, very slow and observed only through Wine/Proton. Upstream platforms: Linux x86-64 package is primary route. Windows preview exists but is explicitly unplayable/very slow and tested only under Wine/Proton; do not offer as playable Windows. Original data: Own PAL/EU Amped 2 original Xbox disc, title 4D530041, XDK 5558, default.xbe SHA-1 38e63cd016bf084d999e0a911933a52191bfc378. Full Redump ISO, game-partition XISO or extracted folder is supported. Keep all disc files in game_files/, with default.xbe directly at its root; other versions are untested. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
